boundaries: No binary, source implementation, SPORE file, or historical triage artifact is modified.
No Simulator service publication, manager construction order, or update-loop call order is inferred from pointer adjacency or vtable layout.
OpenSpore clean-room mode classes are not treated as original SporeApp.exe evidence.
SDK names identify interfaces and layouts; they are not promoted to behavior without a matching body or disassembly.

evidence_policy.decompilation: Committed Ghidra exports and committed read-only live-decompiler summaries are behavior evidence, but decompiler casts and comments remain non-authoritative.
evidence_policy.disassembly: Read-only x86 PE disassembly is used where no committed body exists; labels describe control flow rather than inferred game semantics.
evidence_policy.runtime: Only the committed historical main-menu trace is runtime evidence. It covers app startup, not Simulator manager or gameplay state transitions; the current committed trace is empty.
evidence_policy.sdk_name_only: SDK names, enum values, field offsets, and vtable slots establish interface shape only unless corroborated by body, disassembly, or runtime evidence.
